product_overview: PixL is a digital-out-of-home advertising admin platform for managing screens, playlists, campaigns, and playback analytics. It supports both Admin and Master roles for operating day-to-day signage content and system-wide network management.
core_goals: Sign in as an Admin or Master user to access the appropriate dashboard
Create and launch campaigns targeting one or more screens
Build split-grid campaigns with different playlists assigned to each zone
Upload media assets and assemble them into playlists
Group screens for bulk campaign targeting
Review proof-of-play analytics for assigned screens
Pair new Android TV screens and assign them to an admin
Create and remove admin accounts from the Master panel

features.name: Admin Login
features.description: Authenticate into either the Admin or Master area using email and password with a role selection.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Select Admin Panel or Master Panel -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit the sign-in form -> See the appropriate dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Select Admin Panel or Master Panel -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit the sign-in form -> See an invalid-credentials message or wrong-role message

features.name: Campaign Creation - Single Screen
features.description: Create and launch a campaign that targets one playlist to one or more screens or screen groups.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/campaigns -> Start a new campaign -> Select Single Screen display mode -> Enter a campaign name -> Choose start and end dates -> Select a playlist -> Select one or more target screens or screen groups -> Launch the campaign -> See a success confirmation dialog

features.name: Campaign Creation - Multiple Screen (Split Grid)
features.description: Create a split-screen campaign where each grid zone can play a different playlist on one or more target screens.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/campaigns -> Start a new campaign -> Select Multiple Screen (Split Grid) display mode -> Enter a campaign name -> Choose start and end dates -> Select a grid preset or set rows and columns manually -> Assign a playlist to each zone -> Select one or more target screens or screen groups -> Launch the campaign -> See a split-screen success confirmation dialog

Navigate to /admin/campaigns -> Start a new campaign -> Select Multiple Screen (Split Grid) display mode -> Enter a campaign name -> Choose start and end dates -> Select a grid preset or set rows and columns manually -> Leave one or more zones without a playlist -> Attempt to launch the campaign -> See a warning or validation message about zone assignment

features.name: Screen Grouping
features.description: Organize screens into location groups so campaigns can be targeted in bulk.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/screens -> Open the menu for a screen -> Choose to assign or change its group -> Enter or select a group name -> Save the group assignment
Navigate to /admin/screens -> Create a new group -> Select screens for the group -> Save the group

features.name: Media Upload
features.description: Upload image or video assets for later use in playlists and campaigns.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/media -> Choose a file -> Select an image or video asset -> Review the preview -> Upload the media -> See the upload result

features.name: Playlist Builder
features.description: Create named playlists by selecting one or more uploaded media assets.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/playlists -> Start creating a playlist -> Enter a playlist name -> Select media thumbnails -> Save the playlist -> See the new playlist appear in the list

features.name: Proof of Play Analytics
features.description: Review playback logs showing what content played on each screen and when.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/proof-of-play -> View playback log rows -> Review screen, campaign, media, preview thumbnail, duration, status, and timestamp

features.name: Pair Screen (Master)
features.description: Register a new Android TV screen and assign it to an admin using a pairing code.
user_flows: Navigate to /master/pair -> Enter a screen name -> Enter the 6-digit pairing code -> Enter the admin email -> Pair and assign the screen -> See a success or error message

features.name: Manage Admins (Master)
features.description: Create new admin accounts or remove existing ones from the Master panel.
user_flows: Navigate to /master/admins -> Open the add-admin form -> Enter full name -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Create the admin account -> See the new admin in the list
Navigate to /master/admins -> Open the menu for an existing admin -> Choose delete -> Confirm removal -> See the admin removed from the list

routes.description: Login page with Admin / Master role selector
Admin overview with stat cards and screen status pie chart
View and group screens assigned to the admin
Create and manage playlists from media assets
Analytics table showing playback logs per screen
Master overview with system-wide stats and bar chart

features.name: Admin Login
features.description: Authenticate as Admin or Master using email and password
user_interactions: Select "Admin Panel" or "Master Panel" radio button
See error message on invalid credentials or wrong role

features.name: Campaign Creation - Single Screen
features.description: Create a campaign with a single playlist targeting one or more screens
user_interactions: Check one or more target screens or screen groups

features.name: Campaign Creation - Multiple Screen (Split Grid)
features.description: Create a split-screen campaign with a configurable grid layout (rows x cols). Each zone gets its own playlist. When this campaign type is pushed to screens, the Android TV app switches to GridPlayerActivity (split-screen mode). layoutType must be sent as "SPLIT" to the backend. The grid supports up to 3x3 zones.
user_interactions: Choose grid preset (1x2, 2x1, 2x2) OR select rows (1/2/3) and cols (1/2/3) individually
Assign a playlist to EACH zone in the visual grid preview
Select one or more target screens or groups
Verify success alert shows "Split-Screen (NxN) broadcasted successfully."
known_issues: Zone dropdown shows playlists but zone validation may silently fallback to first playlist if user skips a zone
Submit button disabled check uses layoutMode === 'SINGLE' && !selectedPlaylistId, which means MULTIPLE mode does not enforce zone assignment client-side before the submit button becomes enabled
splitRows and splitCols spinners allow going above 3 if manually typed

features.name: Screen Grouping
features.description: Assign screens to location groups for bulk targeting in campaigns
user_interactions: Click 3-dot menu on a screen card
Type or click an existing group chip
Or click "New Group" to create a group and assign screens via checkboxes

user_interactions: View table rows with screen, campaign, media, preview thumbnail, duration, status, timestamp

user_interactions: Enter 6-digit pairing code shown on Android TV
Enter admin email to assign the screen to

features.name: Manage Admins (Master)

user_interactions: Click "Add Admin" to toggle the registration form
Or click 3-dot menu on an existing admin and select Delete

known_limitations.issue: Split-screen campaign zone assignment is not enforced by the submit button disabled state. The button enables as soon as a name, dates, and at least one screen are selected — even if some zones have no playlist assigned.
known_limitations.impact: User can submit a split campaign with unassigned zones; backend may error or use null playlistId

known_limitations.issue: layoutType value sent to backend uses uppercase "SPLIT" but the Android TV app's isSplit check was case-sensitive before the fix. Any future regression here would silently fall back to single-screen mode on the TV.
known_limitations.impact: Split campaigns may play as single screen on Android TV if case mismatch reoccurs

known_limitations.issue: When creating a campaign in MULTIPLE mode, the preConfirm for the zone grid does not validate that ALL zones have a playlist selected — it only checks each zone when building the zonesArray inside handleSubmit, and shows a Swal warning per-zone. However, the disabled check on the submit button does NOT account for MULTIPLE mode zone completeness, so the user can click Launch even before zones are all assigned.
known_limitations.impact: Poor UX; user gets a per-zone warning Swal after clicking Launch instead of proactive validation

known_limitations.issue: Notifications component (NotificationsLog.jsx) uses a hardcoded localhost URL (http://localhost:8765/api/notifications) instead of the shared API client. This means in production (deployed env), notifications will fail to load.
known_limitations.impact: Notifications page will always show empty or fail in production deployment
